target_negation: there exists n>3 for which every k in 1..floor(n/2) has nonprime k*(n-k)-1
negation_certificate: n, selected modulus residues/root classes, and an exact independently replayed interval-cover digest
exact_residual: A109908 residual = max of the prime-valued image (default 0); A109909 residual = cardinality of that image; the shared negation certificate proves both are 0
